summary: The proposed patch removes a specific string replacement that was causing an issue with test headlines. The change resolves the reported problem without introducing obvious issues.

issues.description: Removing the '.[' to '[' replacement might unintentionally expose other issues or behaviors that were previously hidden by this transformation. This could lead to behavioral regressions if other parts of the code rely on this specific formatting.

The removal of the '.[' to '[' replacement is done without understanding the original intent behind it. This could indicate a fragile approach if there was a reason for this transformation that is not immediately apparent.
